findings.evidence: Phrase: 'hundreds of ordinary apps were found hiding secret deepfake abuse tools.' Art: a yellow robotic claw reaches out of a phone app, unnoticed by a person walking past.
findings.suggestion: Keep the depiction abstract as-is (claw/phone metaphor, no explicit imagery); the humor targets the apps/industry's concealment and public obliviousness, not victims, so this is acceptable but worth a careful re-read before publishing given the underlying topic (sexual abuse deepfakes).
